what: extract() function supports two modes of operation:
title: Pattern-Based Extraction to Link Records on Corporations From a Premade Lookup Table
text: match (Default): Direct comparison. Best short strings lists entities expect text company name. search: Deep extraction. Uses NLP model (UDpipe) identify Proper Nouns within longer unstructured text (sentences) running regex match. NOTE: using mode = “search”, package prompt download ~15MB NLP model first run. model allows package “read” sentence structure.
